'''bounty hunter6 oops! generator got blown up again.''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 10 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed RST hunter6 LS 2003 oopsgene.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is a great one for a quick win. You should be able to jump ahead of your opponent by 16 force and make them put they're hand in used pile on the thrid or the fourth turn, then force drain them to death. REVIEW THIS I'm still open for suggestions I also need 4 more cards in this deck what would you suggest (catman421 and revolution, make sure to check this out (is this any better)).

== Strategy ==

The objective of this deck is not the best but it lets you pull bunker and deactivated the shield generator and "the shield is down" {lets you pull back door to relocate}so your ready to blow up the shield generator. You can basically let most of your weaker scouts die in attempt to hold down the bunker because you can retrieve them once you blow it up. You should have drew up 2 explosive charges or "throw me another charge" by your thrid turn, you need 2 explosive charges on the bunker to blow it up usally(you can track a 4 and 3 or something like that). It stuns your opponent when he has to lose 8 force mostly from his reserve deck because he has to put his hand in used pile and you get to retrieve 8 force. Even if your losing really bad you can turn the game around in just 2 destiny draws. Later in the game force drain a bunch from endor because if they come to kill you "close air support" lets you draw 2 battle destinies (on to total power only)(when you have tala 1 and 2 in the air)(junkin with a concussion grenade is really good)(convert landing and tydrium just land them at rebel landing site and deploy 8 scouts (2 pilots) from reserve deck and move them wherever you want, and restricted deployment w/ goo nee tay will make them pay lots)(you can also activate one extra force for each endor site)  (even if your weaker you can kill them). In this deck there is enough characters to attack them AND hold down endor. You can retrieve a scout of ability less than 3 every turn which means chewie is invincible.
Evenally after a couple battles and force drains they will die. Be kind with the ratings and any suggestions just let me know.
Thanks for all your suggestions...i dont have enough money to buy luke, jedi knight...lol...ill put liberty back in...thanks for the ratings....
